summary: Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a 1-for-15 reverse stock split approved by shareholders at an August 31, 2026 extraordinary general meeting and ratified by the board on September 14, 2026. Outstanding Class A shares drop from about 16,446,750 to 1,096,450 and Class B from 15,125,251 to 1,008,350; par value rises to $0.0015. Trading on NYSE American under symbol POAS begins post-split October 12, 2026, with new CUSIP G7049C120. No fractional shares issue. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch for post-split liquidity and any future financing.
